import java.util.Scanner;

class Main {
    static class Input {
        long mod;
        int n, m;

        boolean read(Scanner sc) {
            if (sc.hasNextInt()) {
                n = sc.nextInt();
                m = sc.nextInt();
                mod = sc.nextLong();
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    static class Data extends Input {
        long ans;

        void write() {
            System.out.println(ans);
        }
    }

    static class Solution extends Data {
        long pw(long x, long y) {
            long res = 1;
            while (y > 0) {
                if ((y & 1) == 1) res = res * x % mod;
                x = x * x % mod;
                y >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        long inv(long x) {
            return pw(x, mod - 2);
        }

        long ss(int x) {
            return (long) x * (x + 1) / 2;
        }

        long[][] c = new long[502][502];
        Pair[] a = new Pair[502];
        Pair[][] d = new Pair[502][502];

        class Pair {
            long first, second;

            Pair(long first, long second) {
                this.first = first;
                this.second = second;
            }
        }

        void solve() {
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
                    if (i == 0 || j == 0) c[i][j] = 1;
                    else c[i][j] = (c[i - 1][j] + c[i][j - 1]) % mod;
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; ++i) {
                a[i] = new Pair(0, 0);
            }
            a[0] = new Pair(1, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
                    Pair cur = new Pair(0, 0);
                    cur.first = a[j].first * a[i - 1 - j].first % mod;
                    cur.second = (a[j].second * a[i - 1 - j].first + a[j].first * a[i - 1 - j].second) % mod;
                    cur.second = (cur.second * (i + 1) + (ss(j) + ss(i - 1 - j)) * cur.first) % mod;
                    cur.first = cur.first * (i + 1) % mod;
                    cur.first = cur.first * c[j][i - 1 - j] % mod;
                    cur.second = cur.second * c[j][i - 1 - j] % mod;
                    a[i].first = (a[i].first + cur.first) % mod;
                    a[i].second = (a[i].second + cur.second) % mod;
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
                    d[i][j] = new Pair(0, 0);
                }
            }
            d[0][0] = new Pair(1, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
                    for (int k = 0; k <= Math.min(n - i, m - j); ++k) {
                        Pair cur = new Pair(0, 0);
                        cur.first = a[k].first * d[i][j].first % mod;
                        cur.second = (a[k].second * d[i][j].first + a[k].first * d[i][j].second) % mod;
                        cur.first = cur.first * c[j][k] % mod;
                        cur.second = cur.second * c[j][k] % mod;
                        d[i + k + 1][j + k] = new Pair(
                                (d[i + k + 1][j + k].first + cur.first) % mod,
                                (d[i + k + 1][j + k].second + cur.second) % mod
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
            ans = d[n + 1][m].second;
        }

        void clear() {
            // Resetting the object is not necessary in Java; re-initialization suffices
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        Solution sol = new Solution();
        if (System.getenv("SG") != null) {
            // In Java, no direct equivalent of freopen; assuming input redirection is handled externally
            while (sol.read(sc)) {
                sol.solve();
                sol.write();
                // No explicit clear needed
            }
        } else {
            if (sol.read(sc)) {
                sol.solve();
                sol.write();
            }
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
